content.short: VRGDAs is an Ethereum-based token issuance mechanism that sets adjustable NFT prices based on demand over a custom schedule.
content.description: VRGDAs, originally developed for the Art Gobblers NFT project, lets creators set dynamic price parameters for selling their NFTs on a custom schedule. Prices adjust automatically with demand: higher demand raises prices, while lower demand lowers them. By tying NFT pricing to the number of units sold rather than market chatter, VRGDAs enables pre-determined pricing with a transparent, rule-based approach that supports planning sales milestones and revenue expectations.
